title: 第二十四章 智不在笔
content_zh:
要打听一个人，江砚有的是法子。

    他这“半个先生”，两个月替坊市里大半的小商户写过信、记过账、念过告示。这些人，三教九流，什么消息都听得见。江砚平日替人写信，本就爱多问两句——问家长里短，问行情冷暖——一来是把信写得贴心，二来，是他打小就有的习惯：摸清一件事的来龙去脉，比什么都要紧。

    如今这习惯，派上了大用场。

    接下来两天，江砚照常开铺子，照常替人写信。只是写着写着，话头就拐到那桩事上。

    “前儿集上来个穿酱色直裰的管事，圆脸，身后跟俩挎刀的——大叔可认得?”他一边给一个卖油的老主顾写信，一边随口问。

    那卖油的“嘶”了一声：“圆脸管事?挎刀的?……莫不是‘赵半城’家的吴管事?”

    江砚心里一动，面上不显：“赵半城?”

    “嗐，城东赵家呗。”卖油的压低声，“这赵老爷，明面上是开当铺、放印子钱的，背地里干的勾当可就杂了。坊市里头小半的市口、铺面，都攥在他手里。谁家欠了他的印子钱还不上，铺子、田、人，都得抵给他。他手底下养着一帮打手，凶得很。这吴管事，就是他跟前最得用的一条狗。”

    江砚一边落笔，一边把这些一字一句记在心里。

    赵半城。当铺，印子钱，市口，打手。

    这就对上了。那嗅迹者多半是受了这赵家的雇，或是攀上了这条线，把他江砚的事报了上去。赵半城贪他这身造物的本事，想把他收作家里一把刀。

    接下来两天，他又从旁人嘴里，一点一点，把这赵半城的底细拼了出来。

    ——赵半城放印子钱，狠是狠，可他最怕一样东西：官面。他那印子钱的利息，早就过了官府明令的数，是犯禁的。他平日里花重金打点着坊市的几个胥吏、巡街的差官，才得以横行。这层皮一旦被捅破，他第一个慌。

    ——赵半城在坊市里有个死对头，是城北另一个放钱的，姓孙。两家为了抢市口，明里暗里斗了好些年，恨不得吃了对方。

    ——赵半城极爱面子，最讲究个“讲规矩”的名声。他横归横，可面上总要做出一副“我赵某人办事，都按坊市的老规矩来”的样子。坊市里头，最重的就是这点“规矩”和“脸面”——谁要是当众被人指着鼻子说“坏了规矩”，在这市面上就抬不起头。

    江砚把这些拢在一处，慢慢琢磨。

    硬刚是死路。赵半城手下几十条打手，他江砚就算把命填进去造十根铁条，也挡不住。

    可这人也不是没有软处。

    他怕官面。他有死对头。他要脸面。

    江砚琢磨了一夜，心里渐渐有了一个法子。

    这法子里头，金手指占的份量极小——他甚至不打算动笔。靠的是坊市的规矩，是人心，是把这赵半城自己那些怕的东西，一样一样，摆到他眼前去。

    ——

    第二天，江砚去寻了一个人。

    是集上那个卖布的老头。

    那日江砚护了他和他孙女，老头一直记着这份恩，三天两头来病坊送些针线小物谢他。江砚问他：“老丈，你这布，往日都卖给哪些人家?可有跟城北孙家有来往的?”

    老头一愣，点头：“有啊。孙家几房太太，都爱买我这松江细棉。怎么了?”

    江砚便低声跟他说了几句。

    老头听得眼睛越睁越大，半晌，重重一拍大腿：“成!这事包在我身上!那姓赵的，坊市里头多少人恨他入骨，敢怒不敢言!小先生你只管说，要我递什么话!”

    江砚要递的话不多。
content_en:
If you want to inquire about a person, Jiang Yan has many methods.

    This "half-sister" has written letters, recorded accounts, and read notices for most of the small merchants in the city in two months. These people come from all walks of life and can hear all kinds of news. Jiang Yan writes letters for others on weekdays, and he likes to ask a few questions - asking about his family background, asking about the current situation - firstly, he writes the letter thoughtfully, and secondly, it is a habit he has had since he was a child: to find out the ins and outs of something is more important than anything else.

    Now this habit has come in handy.

    In the next two days, Jiang Yan opened his shop as usual and wrote letters for others as usual. Just as I was writing, the conversation turned to that matter.

    "There is a steward in Qian'erji who is wearing a brown t-shirt. He has a round face and is followed by two men carrying knives. Can you recognize him?" he asked casually while writing a letter to a regular customer selling oil.

    The oil seller hissed: "The round-faced manager? The one with the knife?... Could it be Manager Wu from the Zhao Bancheng family?"

    Jiang Yan's heart moved, but he didn't show it on his face: "Zhao Bancheng?"

    "Hey, it's the Zhao family in the east of the city." The oil seller lowered his voice, "Mr. Zhao, on the surface he runs a pawn shop and makes loan sharks, but behind the scenes he does a lot of miscellaneous things. Less than half of the market entrances and shops in the market are under control. It's in his hands. Anyone who owes him a loan must pay it back to him. He has a group of thugs who are very fierce. This is the dog he needs the most. "

    Jiang Yan kept these words in mind while writing.

    Zhao Bancheng. Pawn shop, usury, market entrance, thugs.

    That's right. The trace sniffer was probably hired by the Zhao family, or climbed on the line and reported Jiang Yan's incident. Zhao Bancheng was greedy for his ability to create things and wanted to keep him in his family.

    In the next two days, he pieced together the details about Zhao Bancheng from the mouths of others.

    ——Zhao Bancheng is ruthless when it comes to loan sharking, but he is most afraid of one thing: officialdom. The interest on his usury money has long exceeded the amount specified by the government and is illegal. He spends a lot of money on weekdays to manage several minor officials in the market and street patrol officials, so that he can run rampant. Once this layer of skin was pierced, he was the first to panic.

    ——Zhao Bancheng has a rival in Fang City, another money lender in the north of the city, named Sun. In order to grab the market share, the two families have been fighting openly and secretly for several years, eager to eat each other.

    ——Zhao Bancheng loves face very much, and the most important thing is the reputation of being "observant of rules". He was always in trouble, but he always had a look on his face like "I, Mr. Zhao, do everything according to the old rules of the market." In the market, the most important thing is "rules" and "face" - if anyone is pointed at the nose and said "broken the rules" in public, he will not be able to hold his head high in this market.

    Jiang Yan gathered these together and thought about it slowly.

    Being tough is a dead end. Zhao Bancheng had dozens of thugs, and Jiang Yan couldn't stop them even if he put his life in and made ten iron bars.

    But this person is not without weaknesses.

    He is afraid of officialdom. He has a mortal enemy. He wants face.

    Jiang Yan thought about it all night and gradually came up with an idea.

    In this method, Goldfinger played a very small role - he didn't even plan to write. It relies on the rules of the city and the people's hearts, and puts all the things that Zhao Bancheng is afraid of in front of him.

    ——

    The next day, Jiang Yan went to find someone.

    It's the old man selling cloth on the market.

    Jiang Yan protected him and his granddaughter that day. The old man always remembered this kindness and came to the hospital every three days to give him some small things such as needlework and thread to thank him. Jiang Yan asked him: "Old man, who did you sell this cloth to in the past? Do you have any dealings with the Sun family in the north of the city?"

    The old man was stunned and nodded: "Yes. The wives of the Sun family all like to buy my Songjiang fine cotton. What's wrong?"

    Jiang Yan whispered a few words to him.

    The old man's eyes widened as he heard this. After a while, he slapped his thigh hard: "Okay! I'll take care of this! That guy named Zhao, so many people in the city hate him to the core, and they dare not speak out! Young sir, just say whatever you want me to say!"

    Jiang Yan didn't have much to say.
title_en: Chapter 24: Wisdom is not in writing
